name: usd-pipeline
description: Export Houdini SOP geometry to USD and report what landed on disk; Solaris sopimport checks where LOPs are available.

sources.used_for: not merged; it is the official USD-for-Houdini build, not a skill - listed so users know the real dependency for custom USD builds
idea reference for procedural USD authoring; no code copied
idea reference for any-to-any USD exchange; no code copied

flatten_sop_layers.description: Opt-in bind of the usd ROP's 'flattensoplayers'. Verified on 22.0.368: for a SOP Import LOP it changed nothing observable - the requested file still referenced a separate SOP layer and the geometry composed through it either way. Use keep_layers_together to control where the companion layer lands.

default_prim.description: Optional USD default prim path, bound to the ROP's 'defaultprim' parm.

keep_layers_together.description: Pin the SOP Import LOP's own layer (parm 'savepath', default '$HIP/usd/$OS.usd') next to the requested output, so the export travels as one folder. Verified on 22.0.368: with this on the subLayer entry resolves to './<container>_sop.usd'.
